I’m the owner of Global Getaways Travel Agency. Previously Eden Travel Company Check my reviews ! They are 100% Fantastic! Much better than their 3.1.
Before this I was a post office branch manager of Worthing  and Bognor.  I’m. a business woman !
I’ve been with this surgery for over 5 years and just had a dreadful experience with them
I have complex health conditions around 20 !
I’ve just had major surgery for cancer of breast and lymph nodes
These include chronic hypoxia, with 64% oxygen which is very serious and can cause you to lose your life
I have blood clots on the lungs, collapsed lungs, disbetes 2 treated with 5 injections a day!
2 weeks ago I saw Doctor Almashta, I’ve seen him many times, I’ve had ambulances out twice a week as my oxygen has dropped to 64% which is dangerously low,! I was really ill and in hospital and they referred me back to my gp.
I asked him to please refer me back to my respiratory consultant as my condition had worsened and he said it wasn’t possible
and refused to refer me back!
A couple of days later I was so ill with chronic hypoxia with 64% oxygen and an infected 2cm cyst, a wound from my cancer operation that I asked to see a doctor . I met Dr Daryl  I met him for the first time and he asked me about all the health conditions that I had
He treated my cyst and when he looked at my notes from the respiratory consultant it said that if  my condition deteriorated  I should be referred back to him
There has been a catalogue of errors!!
Nicole the  nurse has gone behind my back and made a false accusation
My nurse for my wound dressing Hannah the
one  who was redressing my cancer wound
saw that it had deteriorated and called Doctor Chris in. He said it was so bad that he needed to refer me to a specialist dealing with Tissue who would treat it until it get better. He asked Hannah to take a swab and she forgot to do it and redressed  my wound !
Nula the receptionist is very rude and her mission is to stop you at any cost from  seeing a doctor. My sisters husband died and the next day she phoned and asked to see a doctor and Nula refused to let her see one!
My sister was devasted and from that day to this has had so bad anxiety that she can’t face going again!
Dr Giles in the last few days has treated me sometimes like an animal!
But has also shown me a nice side too
She stroked my hand, made me a cup of tea and then made a false accusation against me
Today I had requested a home visit and the receptionist told me they wanted me to come in despite having walking difficulties. Then the receptionist called me and said the home visit doctor was on his way.  Doctor Giles then confirmed that there was no doctor!!
This catalogue of errors has caused me so much stress and from that my medical conditions have worsened
Tomorrow I’m. finding a new doctors surgery to move to!!
I give cathedral group 1/10
